request: 会话刻度提供鼠标悬停预览，并说明精简会话的效果

behavior.pointer: 120ms 悬停后预览真实提问，移出 160ms 后收起；刻度与浮层之间可连续移动
behavior.pin: 点击或键盘激活固定目录，再次点击、点击外部或 Escape 关闭
behavior.focus: Escape 恢复刻度按钮焦点；浮层内有键盘焦点时不因指针移出而隐藏
behavior.passivePreview: 只悬停不触发 onOpen，不暂停正文跟随；固定或定位才进入阅读状态
behavior.copy: 按提问快速定位，完整记录保留
behavior.compactConversation: 主视图在两行内更新普通进展，最终结论单独显示；完整过程可展开，并可通过提问目录定位历史
behavior.content: 仅展示已有真实提问，不新增模型摘要请求，不改变持久历史

checks.hover: Pointer entering the rail hover area expands the panel; fixed-directory counter remains zero
checks.leave: Moving the pointer outside via scrolling closes an unpinned preview
checks.pinned: Keyboard Enter opens and pins; moving the pointer outside does not close
checks.keyboard: Escape closes and returns focus to the rail trigger
checks.navigation: Selecting the fourth question records u3 and jumps to its actual turn

dev.acceptance: Real 26-turn conversation directory opens with the concise explanation and existing question previews; Escape closes it. The user conversation was paused before installation and no remote operation was triggered.
